title: Kabuğuna Sığmayan Yengeç - Karnı Acıkan Kedi - Uykusu Kaçan Kaplumbağa - Yardımsever Kanguru - Mis Kokulu Kokarca -Kral Olmak İstemeyen Aslan - Evi Eriyen Kutup Ayısı - Sesini Arayan Zürafa - 8'li seri
author: Ezo Sunal
description: Every child needs a fairy tale, and every fairy tale needs a narrator. In this series, children meet different animals with different problems to solve. As they read, they learn that problems are a part of life but can often be solved with the help of friends. The books invite readers to journey alongside the animals through their colorful worlds.
